physics-killer-04.material: A ball is thrown horizontally from the edge of a $20\,\mathrm{m}$ high cliff and lands on the ground at a horizontal distance of $30\,\mathrm{m}$ from the cliff. Use $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ and ignore air resistance. Which option correctly gives, in order, the speed of the ball the instant it reaches the ground and $\tan\theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle its velocity makes with the horizontal at that instant?
physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Collisions and Safety, Horizontal Projection and Gravity
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: A ball is thrown horizontally from the edge of a $20\,\mathrm{m}$ high cliff and lands on the ground at a horizontal distance of $30\,\mathrm{m}$ from the cliff. Use $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ and ignore air resistance. Which option correctly gives, in order, the speed of the ball the instant it reaches the ground and $\tan\theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle its velocity makes with the horizontal at that instant?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Vertically $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Horizontally $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Just before landing $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Adding the components as $v_0+gt=35$ gives option 1; inverting the tangent gives $\frac34$ (option 2); using only the vertical component $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ as the speed gives option 4.

Which option correctly gives, in order, the speed of the ball the instant it reaches the ground and $\tan\theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle its velocity makes with the horizontal at that instant?
physics-killer-04.steps.0.explain: Vertically $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Horizontally $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Just before landing $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Adding the components as $v_0+gt=35$ gives option 1; inverting the tangent gives $\frac34$ (option 2); using only the vertical component $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ as the speed gives option 4.
